title: REQ · Admin routes sit behind token entry and manage the Round
summary: Token form, current World and Round, config fields, open/close, contributions list
description: Context: no admin UI exists. Desired behavior: hash route #/admin renders AdminApp; without a token only a password-type token form shows; with a token it shows the World, the Round id/number/status, duration and max-contribution fields, Open and Close buttons calling POST /api/v1/admin/rounds/{id}/open|close?world=, and the contributions list from GET .../contributions. The token is held in component state only. Why: admins operate Rounds.
acceptance_criteria: Given no token, then only the token form renders and no admin fetch occurs
Given a token submitted, then GET /api/v1/admin/rounds/{id} runs with header Authorization: Bearer <token>
Given the Round, when Open or Close is clicked, then the matching POST runs with the world query
Given contributions, then the list shows each prompt
Given a 401 response, then the token form shows 'Invalid token'

in_scope: AdminApp, TokenGate, admin client calls, hash routing in main/App
out_of_scope: Duration saved to server beyond POST /admin/rounds create

technical_constraints: Admin Get uses ?world= query; duration sent as Go duration string on create
